subject: Ice Cavern
text: Collecting all five Silver Rupees in the spinning ice fan room opens the gate.

evidence.quote: From the entrance where you came in, go left and break the three icicles to find the fourth Silver Rupee.  Lastly from the entrance go right and climb up to the gate, you can jump off from here to acquire the fifth and final Silver Rupee which will open the gate.

subject: Gold Skulltula 065
text: Gold Skulltula 065 is found high on the wall in the spinning ice fan room where the icicles were broken.

evidence.quote: Before you leave the room, head back over to where you broke the icicles and look up on the wall, there you will see a GOLD SKULLTULA [065].

subject: Dungeon Map
text: Melting the red ice encased around the large treasure chest with Blue Fire yields the Dungeon Map.

evidence.quote: Cross the walkway and you'll come to a large hunk of red ice with a large treasure chest frozen inside it.  Use the Blue Flame to melt the ice and open the chest to get the DUNGEON MAP for this semi-dungeon.

subject: Purple Rupee
text: Melting the red ice on the pillar and breaking the pot reveals a Purple Rupee.

evidence.quote: Turn around and jump to that pillar with the red ice hunk on it.  Use the Blue Fire to melt it and then beak the pot, you should find a PURPLE RUPEE inside.

subject: Compass
text: Melting the red ice on the right reveals a large chest containing the Compass.

evidence.quote: Melt the red ice on your right and then open the large chest to acquire the dungeon's COMPASS.

subject: Piece of Heart 025
text: Melting the red ice on the left side reveals Piece of Heart 025.

evidence.quote: Next melt the red ice on the left side and pick up the PIECE OF HEART [025].

subject: Gold Skulltula 066
text: Gold Skulltula 066 is located on the wall above where Piece of Heart 025 was found.

evidence.quote: PIECE OF HEART [025]. ... Equip your Hookshot and then look up above where you got the Piece of Heart to find GOLD SKULLTULA [066].

subject: Gold Skulltula 067
text: Gold Skulltula 067 is found crawling on the left wall past the entrance of the large block puzzle room.

evidence.quote: From the entrance go left and then look left to find yet another GOLD SKULLTULA [067] crawling around on this wall here, be careful though because the ground doesn't entirely cover the area and it's very possible to fall down and wind up at the beginning of the dungeon again.

subject: Ice Cavern
text: To collect the Silver Rupees in the sliding block room, push the block west, climb it for the second, push it north and melt red ice for the third, then respawn the block, push it south for the fourth, and push it west for the fifth to open the gate.

evidence.quote: Push it west in the direction you are moving when you enter the room and hen climb on top of it and get the second Silver Rupee from the pillar.  After this push the block north and then climb up it, use the Blue Fire to melt the red ice and get the third Silver Rupee... This time push the block south and climb up onto it to get the next Silver Rupee.  Push it west following this and climb up onto it, you should be able to pick up the fifth Silver Rupee easily which opens the gate.

subject: Ice Cavern
text: To reach the exit ledge after the block respawns at the entrance, push the block west, south, and west to reach the Blue Fire, then push it south, east, and south to jump up to the opened gate hallway.

evidence.quote: When it respawns at the entrance to the room, push it west, then south, then west.  Jump from the block up to the blue torch and some bottles with Blue Fire.  Jump back down and push it south, then east, then south.  From here you should be able to jump from the block up to the hall where the gate opened.

subject: White Wolfos
text: The wolf miniboss can be defeated by blocking its attack with the shield and executing a jumping attack with the A button while its guard is down.

evidence.quote: use your shield constantly and attack the wolf only after he attacks you.  The jumping A button attack works great because you don't have to manually lower you shield to use it, just hit A after defending against one of his attacks when the wolf's guard is down.

subject: Iron Boots
text: Defeating the wolf miniboss causes a large treasure chest to appear in the center of the room containing the Iron Boots.

evidence.quote: When the wolf is defeated a large chest appears in the middle of the room, it contains IRON BOOTS.

subject: Serenade of Water
text: After acquiring the Iron Boots, a scene plays where Link learns the Serenade of Water.

evidence.quote: After this there is another scene where you learn the SERENADE OF WATER.

subject: Zora Tunic
text: Using Blue Fire to thaw King Zora frees him and rewards Link with the Zora Tunic, which allows breathing underwater.

evidence.quote: Use the Blue Fire to free him and then speak to the king.  As a way of saying thank you, he will give you the ZORA TUNIC which allows you to breathe underwater.

subject: Piece of Heart 026
text: Bombing the base of the lone yellow tree northwest of Lon Lon Ranch opens a grotto where sinking to the bottom with Iron Boots yields Piece of Heart 026.

evidence.quote: Instead ride the horse northwest of the ranch and step beside the lone yellow tree.  When you get off you should feel your controller rumbling when you stand beside the tree.  Place a bomb there at the base and it will blast a hole in the ground.  Down here is a small body of water, what you need to do is swim into it and equip the Iron Boots.  You will sink down to the bottom and acquire a PIECE OF HEART [026].

subject: Piece of Heart 027
text: Riding the Magic Bean plant beside the Lakeside Laboratory to the roof and climbing the ladder leads to Piece of Heart 027.

evidence.quote: When you arrive there, make your way over to the laboratory thing beside the bridge and step on the Magic Bean plant.  When it rises up, jump off immediately onto the roof of the house and climb the ladder... At the top here you will find PIECE OF HEART [027].

subject: Golden Scale
text: Catching the enormous fish swimming around the broken logs in the center of the Fishing Pond weighing at least fifteen pounds awards the Golden Scale, enabling diving for nine seconds.

evidence.quote: Your goal is to catch the fish in the very middle of the pond, the enormous one swimming around the broken logs and stuff, it's pretty much always in the same place... This fish should be at least fifteen pounds or more, which will net you the reward GOLDEN SCALE and allow you to dive underwater for nine seconds as opposed to six.

subject: Gold Skulltula 068
text: Rolling into the crate at the bottom of the Lakeside Laboratory pool reveals Gold Skulltula 068.

evidence.quote: Equip the Iron Boots and jump into the water, have your Hookshot equipped as well.  At the very bottom, roll into the crate down here and a GOLD SKULLTULA [068] will pop out, you can kill it using the Hookshot.

subject: Piece of Heart 028
text: Diving to the very bottom of the Lakeside Laboratory pool using the Golden Scale and speaking to the scientist awards Piece of Heart 028.

evidence.quote: Now swim to the very bottom of this pond using your new Gold Scale, not you Iron Boots and speak to the man to acquire PIECE OF HEART [028].

subject: Compass
text: Standing beside the water spray and firing an arrow at the crystal switch allows opening the large chest to obtain the Compass.

evidence.quote: Up here there is a crystal and a large chest which cannot be opened due to a water spray.  What you need to do (well actually there are tons of solutions) is stand beside the water spray and chest, then fire an arrow from your Fairy Bow at the crystal.  Open the large chest while it is momentarily available to get the COMPASS.

subject: Dungeon Map
text: Using a spinning sword attack to defeat the spike traps when they transform into small rocks spawns a large chest containing the Dungeon Map.

evidence.quote: What you need to do is simply run away from them until they transform into small rocks, this is their alternate form.  While in this form you can simply perform a spinning sword attack to destroy them all and spawn a large treasure chest.  Inside the chest you will find the DUNGEON MAP for this dungeon.

subject: Water Temple
text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby beside the Triforce symbol plaque lowers the water level.

evidence.quote: In this room on one of the walls there is a Triforce symbol plaque that you can see.  What you want to do is stand beside this symbol and play Zelda's Lullaby on your Ocarina.  This will lower the water level.

subject: Water Temple
text: Aligning the center flame with the corner torches and firing arrows through it ignites the torches and unlocks the door.

evidence.quote: Stand at the entrance of this room so that the torch in the middle is aligned in your view with one of the torches in the corner and then equip your Fairy Bow.  You're done this before, when you fire an arrow through a flame the arrow becomes engulfed in flames itself, this is how you light the torches in the corners.  Once the torches are lit the door opens up and you can go through.

subject: Small Key
text: Defeating all three clam enemies with sword strikes before they charge spawns a small chest in the center of the room containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote: When you get close to one of them they open up but then after a split second, they charge at you.  What you have to do is run up to them and be ready to swing your sword right away before they charge, it only takes a single hit to kill them.  After all three of them are dead then a small chest appears in the centre of the room containing a SMALL KEY.

subject: Water Temple
text: The Water Temple is located underwater in the middle of Lake Hylia on the north side of the centre island, and reaching the gate requires equipping the Iron Boots and the Hookshot.

evidence.quote: The Water Temple is located in the middle of Lake Hylia, on the north side of the centre island but underwater.  You need to equip the Iron Boots and the Hookshot and then jump down to the gate.
